heading: Superintendence of Navy hospitals
lead: The Secretary of the Navy shall have the general charge and superintendence of Navy hospitals.

notes.text: Codification R.S. § 4807 derived from acts Feb. 26, 1811, ch. 26, § 1, 2 Stat. 650; July 10, 1832, ch. 194, § 5, 4 Stat. 573.
